text:
Four satellite sensor sets were checked using NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data:

- VIIRS on Suomi NPP
- VIIRS on NOAA-20
- VIIRS on NOAA-21
- MODIS

All four covered every day of the period from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03 over the whole asset (ASSET-F03). The Suomi NPP coverage appears as two consecutive segments, split at 2026-11-02, with no gap.

None of them recorded a thermal detection intersecting the asset (count 0).

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the ground, or anything outside this period. The data reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12.
